assignments.value: ={{ (function(){ try{ const r=($('Resolve Creator Handle').last?$('Resolve Creator Handle').last():$('Resolve Creator Handle').first()); const h=String((r&&r.json&&r.json.streamer_handle)||'').trim().replace(/^@+/,''); if(h && !/^(streamer|malik)$/i.test(h)) return h; }catch(e){} try{ const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const ef=($('Edit Fields').last?$('Edit Fields').last():$('Edit Fields').first()); const sf=String((ef&&ef.json&&ef.json.stream_file)||'').trim(); if(sf){ const stem=sf.replace(/(\.processing)?\.mp4$/i,''); for(const ip of [path.join('/files/inputs',stem+'.processing.info.json'),path.join('/files/inputs',stem+'.info.json'),path.join('/files/inputs',sf+'.info.json')]){ if(fs.existsSync(ip)){ const info=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ip,'utf8')); let uid=String(info.uploader_id||'').trim().replace(/^@/,''); const up=String(info.uploader||info.channel||'').trim().replace(/^@/,''); if(/^UC[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$/.test(uid) && up) uid=up; const raw=(uid||up).replace(/\s+/g,''); if(raw) return raw; } } const atM=sf.match(/@([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/); if(atM) return atM[1]; const chM=sf.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+?)_(?:vod_\d+|[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})_chunk\d+/i)||sf.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9-]+_?)_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+_chunk\d+/i)||sf.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+_chunk\d+/i); if(chM) return chM[1]; const prM=sf.match(/^(?:\d+_Top_)?([A-Za-z0-9_]+)___/i); if(prM) return prM[1]; } }catch(e2){} return String($json.streamer_handle||$json.streamer_name||'Streamer').trim().replace(/^@+/,'')||'Streamer'; })() }}
